answer.rationale: The low-cost vendor is the only stated path that independently meets the mandated 18% spend reduction before the contract expires. Prior learning indicates rapid onboarding and accurate invoicing, but it does not establish delivery performance under a 94%-loaded assembly schedule. Verify the archived record for evidence on delivery reliability, capacity, and transition execution before committing; if those are not supported, the delivery-risk constraint may outweigh the apparent unit-cost advantage.
